item.description:
Torrid 0.1.3

Wording cleanup.

  • Settings: the video tools are now listed by name (yt-dlp, script runtime, FFmpeg), and three explanatory sentences were removed from the Video, BitTorrent and Speed Limits pages.
  • About window: shorter tagline.

Torrid 0.1.3（简体中文）

文案整理。

  • 设置：视频工具按名字列出（yt-dlp、JavaScript 运行环境、FFmpeg）；视频、BT、限速三页各去掉一句说明。
  • 关于窗口：一句话简介更短了。

Torrid 0.1.2

A small follow-up to 0.1.1.

  • BitTorrent: Torrid now identifies itself to peers and trackers as Torrid (client code “TO”) instead of borrowing another client’s code. Private trackers that check the client identity will see a consistent peer ID and user agent.

Torrid 0.1.2（简体中文）

0.1.1 的一个小补丁。

  • BT：Torrid 现在以自己的身份（客户端代号「TO」）向其他节点和 tracker 报到，不再借用别家客户端的代号。会核对客户端身份的私有站看到的 peer ID 与 User-Agent 从此一致。

Torrid 0.1.1

A polish release based on daily use. No new features; everything reported in the first weeks got fixed.

  • Downloads: the speed limit is now smooth (no more swinging above and below the limit), and fast servers are used to the full — several connections even when the server speaks HTTP/2 or HTTP/3.
  • After a crash, downloads that were running stay paused until you resume them; a normal quit still continues them on the next launch.
  • Removing a task: Delete removes the task and keeps the files, Command-Delete moves the files to the Trash. No confirmation dialog; rows fade out.
  • The list shows real file icons (folders for folder torrents), a fixed-width speed column with direction arrows, and KB / MB units. The toolbar and status bar are simpler; download and upload speeds are always visible.
  • Pause and Resume in the toolbar also stop and start seeding for finished torrents.
  • Settings: speed limits are a checkbox plus a value, number fields can be typed into, the highest-quality choice is a segmented control, the BitTorrent port can be checked from the Internet with Return, and the window is always titled “Settings”.
  • Fixed a crash when removing tasks, and a case where a web link could launch a second copy of the app.
  • New app icon, drawn with the system’s Liquid Glass material.

Torrid 0.1.1（简体中文）

根据日常使用反馈做的精修版。没有新功能，第一批用下来发现的问题都修了。

  • 下载：限速平稳了（不再在上限上下来回摆）；快的服务器能跑满——服务器用 HTTP/2、HTTP/3 时也开多条连接。
  • 崩溃后，原本在跑的任务停在「暂停」等你确认；正常退出的下次打开照旧继续。
  • 移除任务：Delete 只删任务、文件留着，Command-Delete 把文件移到废纸篓。不再弹确认框；行会淡出。
  • 列表显示真实的文件图标（文件夹形式的 BT 就是文件夹）、定宽带箭头的速度列、KB / MB 单位；工具栏和底栏更简洁，下载与上传速度常显。
  • 工具栏的暂停 / 继续也管做完的 BT：暂停 = 停止做种，继续 = 开始做种。
  • 设置：限速改成开关 + 数值，数字框能直接输入，画质上限改成分段选择，BT 端口按回车可以检测外网是否可达，窗口标题固定叫「设置」。
  • 修了移除任务时的闪退，以及网页链接可能再开一个 App 的问题。
  • 新的 App 图标，用系统的 Liquid Glass 材质渲染。
